## Shared/Design System Patterns (across all)

- **Color/theme system:** CSS custom property tokens under `:root` (`--unap-blue-*`, `--slate-*`, `--success-*`, `--warn-*`, etc.), standard white cards w/ round `--radius` — proximity; permissive soft “button” -- basic / primary / etc.
- **Typography**: `--font-sans`, `--font-mono` used for all labels+data?; uppercase eyebrow styles across steps; mono-styled numbers/statistics.
- **Components** usually combine light/b&w; brand blue–and–gold accents; small details like rounded full-pill tag/chip components, hover, sliding SVG.
- The overall design style is a “back-office daily dashboard” clean, brand-colored (UNMSM style) in Spanish; it revolves around data tables, process status badges, upload/import action insights and drills; all components are closely tightened.
- **Responsive behavior:** horizontally scrolling tables, sidebar collapses, mobile toolbar columns, upload/full preview, responsive card grids; making this a heavily responsive interface.

## Design Philosophy Summary

| Priority | Pattern |
|---|---|
| Visual hierarchy | Header logos (branded) → gradient blue+gold primary CTAs → sidebar navigation | data grid |
| Data emphasis | Full-width tables with hover/edit, header sort, pagination/chips; multi-row statistics; long-text mono-font cells; status badges are used judiciously; table labels subtle UPPER; etc. |
|---|---|
| Interaction model | Edit-in-row dataset (no modal except manual row adding), inline bulk actions w/ confirmation, paginating/interacting with data components. |
| Color usage | The Unap 600 `blue` dominant → neutral `slate`, `soft` success green, gold highlights, warning yellow, white existing archive uploads etc. |

## Design tokens summary (all CSS)
The global token system should be a multi-layer **CSS custom property** (the `:root` CSS uses current brand token-vars), always preceded by values in **headings**: `--font-sans`, `--font-mono`, `--space-*`,`--radius-*`, `--shadow-*`, `--transition-*` plus `--blue` `gold` `slate` `success` `warning` variants (breakfast w/ `*-50`/`*-100`/`*.600-900`).
